name: @neurobrau/llm-cli-typescript
description: NeuroBräu TypeScript — a terminal-based multi-provider LLM client

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', '.test-dist']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.clean:test: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
